# [TASK] SonarQube Integration and Code Quality Cleanup

## Task
SonarQube static-analysis integration and code-quality cleanup across all backend modules.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] SonarQube (CE) + Gradle plugin wired, aggregate JaCoCo coverage across all modules
- [x] Quality gate passing — 0 bugs, 0 vulnerabilities, 0 code smells (down from 143 open issues)
- [x] All fixable findings fixed in code — including the one real bug (a DST-unsafe `DateUtils.hoursBetween`); the rest are justified per-occurrence (WONTFIX/false-positive) or covered by 2 deactivated rules
- [x] Coverage reported at 84.8% over 4732 ncloc
- [x] Findings and quality-profile rationale documented — `docs/architecture/CODE_QUALITY.md`, `infrastructure/sonarqube/filmpire-way-java-profile.xml`
